name: Plate Front Raise
cues: Hold a plate by its sides at thigh level
Raise it forward to eye level with your arms nearly straight
Keep your torso still and your ribs down
Lower slowly back to your thighs

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. needs work: Bottom of the rep: the plate is tipped 59 deg (quat x 0.493), close to a tray. The arms stop at elevation 25 with the rims at y 0.81 m and z 0.22, about 20 cm in front of the thighs, so 'lower slowly back to your thighs' never happens. The wrists use only -9 to +12 deg of deviation. The fingers also need a 22 mm rest-tolerance override, and the forward balance runs at 30.2 of 35 mm. The top is fine: plate centre at 1.66 m (eye level), elbow 5-15. | minor: Fixed in front-raise.ts, plate branch only. plateTilt now keeps 0.45 x (90 - elev) - 12 (was 90 - elev - 8). A new eased rim obliquity (GripTarget.oblique, 0 -> 40 deg between elevation 100 and 15) takes the rest of the turn, so the wrists don't hit their band corner. A first try without the easing gave a 78k deg/s3 wrist jerk. devBand is widened to [-22, 18] (limit 20) and thighClear goes from 12 to 4 mm. The 22 mm rest tolerance is unchanged (lead's call).
